text: Les KL be a triangle, having its base Ll bisected at p, and let Hå, any straight line parallel to the base, and terminates by the sides. As bisected at P, then Y, p., the points of insertion, and K, the vertex of the triangle, are in the same straight lines; and that line bisects Dd, any other straight line parallel to the base.
